caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers in a three-quarter view, showing both the front and left side. The chest consists of four horizontal drawers, each equipped with two circular knobs as handles. The color of the chest is a uniform brown, with visible wood grain texture rendered throughout the surfaces. The chest stands on four short legs featuring simple, curved bracket feet. There are no other objects in the drawing, and the background is plain and off-white. In the bottom right corner, the name "JESUS M. PENA." is written in small letters.
title: Chest of Drawers
